# Assets · Icons

50 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for home.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Icons

Fifty icons from Lucide 0.378.0 (ISC licence, text in `licenses/Lucide-ISC.txt`), 24px, stroke 1.75, drawn in `ink` (#14213D).

- In a page, inline the SVG, remove its `stroke` attribute and add class `cyp-icon`: the icon then takes the colour of the text around it, or white inside a `cyp-disc`.
- As `<img>` the files stay `ink`: use them that way on `surface` and `surface-soft` only.
- Add an icon only from the same Lucide version, with the same stroke.
